reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every skip and move path already calls.

duplication.why: A two-line change in the single holiday predicate; nothing is repeated.

placement.why: The holiday matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the predicate lives.

scope.why: Only the predicate and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and central; matching MM-DD via day.slice(5) is a little implicit about the date format but commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, schedules/app getUpcomingDates) go through isNonWorkingDay.
